shared_elements: solar disc at the apex of the arch
figures facing one another across a central element
registers of hieroglyphic-style sign rows and columns
offering/altar or staff-like object handled by a figure
framing line following the curve of the top
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme: an arched panel whose apex carries a sun disc with cartouche name-rings beneath it, below which profile human figures in tall headdresses confront each other across a central element, with rows of small script signs filling the remainder — a highly conventional and specific combination unlikely to arise independently. The main differences in content are that B devotes most of the surface to many packed lines of text with an offering table and subsidiary small figures, while A gives the confronting pair (one grasping a long staff, one with a raised disc-topped emblem) nearly the whole field with only a narrow inscribed strip.
